parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities to assays on assay_id and filter assays where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3705858'. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno for the molecule ChEMBL ID. Inner join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter to rows where standard_value is not null, standard_relation is not null, and standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
